page.layout: One printed title page, one column, centred. Below the text a woodcut engraving (tree with a figure and a bird, a town in the background). Below the engraving the printed Bible citation and its verse. Below that the place and date of printing. In the lower margin, handwritten dedication (not printed, so not transcribed).

main_text.l: ADDIDIMUS item Indices duos, Rerum scilicet & Ver-
borum, Locorum item Sacræ Scripturæ quæ in

l.i: Amen amen dico vobis quæcunque petieritis patrem

page.notes: Woodcut engraving between the title and the citation: a tree with spreading branches, a figure beside it, a bird in the air, a town with a church tower at the right. Not transcribed. Handwritten dedication in the lower margin, in ink, not printed: "C.V. Dno Jo. Rodolpho Stumpfio E.T.M. Dno & fautori suo imprimis obseruando. Heinrichus Vvolphius d.d." Not transcribed. A handwritten "1" in the top right corner and a faint pencil or ink mark near the title, not printed, not transcribed. The first line of the title is printed in capitals; the "V." of "LIBRUM V." is printed as a Roman numeral. Printed hyphens at the line ends are kept as "-".
